about: the job is accepted but the video id is unknown to the status endpoint (404 Not found, Django REST framework's body)

reads.note: GET https://sisif.ai/api/videos/<id>/ after each 10 s wait, replied in turn (the last repeats). Shape: the API client's VideoResponse (id, prompt, status PENDING/PROCESSING/READY/ERROR, video_url, duration, resolution, featured, created_at, updated_at); a deleted or never-stored job

body.prompt: Generate video about a young couple relaxing on a quiet white-sand beach at sunset on their honeymoon, slow pans, chill holiday mood

connector.none: no captured Sisif connector; the Claude side gets the same response through its HTTP mock

writeReplies.note: HTTP Request v4.1 POST https://sisif.ai/api/videos/generate/ with Bearer auth, JSON body {prompt: <the chain's idea>, duration: "5", resolution: "540x960"} (bodyParameters, so the values are strings). Response shape from the Sisif API client (vtemian/sisif-ai-mcp: VideoGenerationResponse id, status, prompt, duration, resolution, estimated_completion, credits_used, created_at); the echoed prompt is fixed here, while n8n sends the model's idea

branches: Check Video Status meets 404: HTTP Request without continue-on-fail stops the run; Video Ready? never runs
expect.offline: The idea is a model reply (recorded on the n8n side), so the request body's prompt is whatever the model wrote; the fixture's echoed prompt is fixed. Each loop turn waits 10 s in n8n (Wait 10s, kept). The template's resolution 540x960 is not one of the API client's presets (low, medium, high); the fixture answers as if the API took it. Prepare Final Data reads sisif_id, which the API does not return, so watch_url ends in undefined on both sides by design
